essence: Therefore the speaker offers reverent salutation to that paradoxical benefactor.
Therefore one should give an offering according to capacity so that the teacher is satisfied.
Therefore a father suffers a dire consequence as long as his son remains in distress.
Therefore this knowledge is supremely efficacious, granting both the four goals and all accomplishments.
Therefore the mantra of Tāriṇī is declared to be nine-syllabled.
